_cut_method: Every cut lands inside a silence window measured on vo.mp3 with ffmpeg silencedetect=noise=-30dB:d=0.09 (and cross-checked at -38dB). Cut timecodes are the midpoints of those windows, so no cut falls on a phoneme. The two [PAUSE] windows measured at 8.764-9.611 (0.848s) and 38.892-39.789 (0.897s) are held inside a single scene each — no cut crosses either one.
_layering: Archive on the bottom (desaturate 0.4 + grain 0.06 per bible SS5 / --pa-archive-saturation), data layer on top: flat, sharp, no shadow. Amber #C8964B = every 2016 figure, cyan #00E5FF = every 2026 figure, white = derived/index data. Tokens read from brand/tokens.css and config/channel.yaml this session, not from memory.
_slideshow_guard: 9 of 20 scenes are stills. Every still carries an explicit push and none is held static: the longest single still hold is 3.326s (s19) at push 1.06 with the stamp entrance and a second text layer inside it. The four moving-footage sources were motion-profiled this session (mean inter-frame luma delta on a 64x48 decode) and every in-point chosen sits in a measured high-motion window; nortex_walkthrough is handheld throughout (M 25-45) and carries the beats where a still would stall.
_odometer_note: Fires exactly once, scene s19 excluded, on s5 (GAP), 800ms, cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1). It starts 0.847s after the 2026 figure finishes being spoken, i.e. on the first frame after [PAUSE] #1, landing 0.078s before 'Same size.' ends. The pause is the wind-up; the roll is the landing. Not restyled, not re-timed.
_evidence_discrepancy: evidence.json claim c5 carries inflation_adjusted_value: 67.4, which contradicts its own text and quoted BLS arithmetic (76.2%). script.md flags the same thing. Scene s16 shows -76.2%, matching the spoken line and the quoted index values (283.408 -> 93.176 against CPI-U 239.261 -> 330.724). trend-archaeologist still needs to reconcile the field; this plan does not paper over it.
